_comment: StubHub repricer config. No secrets here (Gmail creds live in ~/.config/stubhub-repricer/env). Prices on StubHub are ALL-IN (incl. buyer fee); the engine compares all-in-to-all-in and converts to a seller list price using buyer_fee_pct (null -> 0.27 default) only for the floor check and the price to type. our_seat lets the engine exclude your own listing (verify it via --probe). compare_mode: 'section' compares against any row in your section (recommended, since you're usually the only seller in your exact row); 'row' compares only same/similar rows (row_tolerance). event_datetime only stops management after the match. fee_rate is your StubHub seller commission estimate; the authoritative payout floor is checked live at apply-time. our_listing_id is optional (capture from the listing URL after --login) for precise self-exclusion.
